note: Every pixel of the frieze is from one photograph. Nothing is drawn: the tiles are cut along their own joints, the shadow is the photograph's own.

frieze.webp.what: The bottom row of a panel of Kashan lustre star and cross tiles (five stars, four crosses), cut out along the tiles' joints from one photograph, with the photograph's own cast shadow. 2400 x 766, RGBA.
frieze.webp.source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, photograph DP231256, published with object 444459 (accession 91.1.106) and its panel group

frieze-tiles.png.what: Derived data at the same size: normal (R,G), tile id and lustre density (B). Made by tools/bake.py from the photograph above.

panel.assembled: The panel was put together by The Met from tiles of several accessions; the Met's own key ('tile panel key', 'Final version, checked with cards and pinned, 10 1974') names each position.
